input.summary: Rework Section 15 to give Client affiliate/successor assignment rights, restrict TrueLink assignment, and bar any change-of-control termination.
input.comment: [Playbook] We made the assignment clause asymmetric as our playbook requires: Client may assign to an affiliate or transaction successor without approval and a change of control of Client gives TrueLink no termination right, while TrueLink may assign only with our consent, not unreasonably withheld, and never to a competitor of Client.

ops.oldText: Neither party shall assign or transfer any of its rights under this Agreement without the prior written approval of the other party, except no such approval shall be required for an assignment to a financially responsible affiliate.
ops.newText: Client may assign or transfer its rights under this Agreement without approval to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets, and a change of control of Client shall give TrueLink no right to terminate this Agreement. TrueLink shall not assign or transfer any of its rights under this Agreement without the prior written approval of Client, which shall not be unreasonably withheld, and shall never assign to a competitor of Client.
